Compute conversion rate as 100*orders/visits and cumulative orders as the running sum of orders. Create two vertically stacked panels sharing the x axis. The top panel must contain blue bars for visits on the left y axis and an orange circle-marker line for conversion rate on a twin right y axis. The bottom panel must contain a purple step plot of cumulative orders using where=`mid`, with every cumulative value annotated. Give the top left axis label `Visits`, top right axis label `Conversion Rate (%)`, and bottom y axis label `Cumulative Orders`; label the bottom x axis `Month`. Include a combined legend in the upper left of the top panel, turn on a horizontal dashed grid in both panels, and set the exact suptitle `Monthly Funnel Performance`. Make the figure 9 by 7 inches at 120 dpi and save it as figure.png.

{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > create_figure.py
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Data
months = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun']
visits = [1000, 1200, 900, 1500, 1800, 1600]
orders = [50, 72, 63, 120, 162, 128]

# Compute conversion rate and cumulative orders
conversion_rate = 100 * np.array(orders) / np.array(visits)
cumulative_orders = np.cumsum(orders)

# Create figure with two vertically stacked subplots
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(9, 7), dpi=120, sharex=True)

# Top panel - Visits and Conversion Rate
bars = ax1.bar(months, visits, color='blue', label='Visits')
ax1.set_ylabel('Visits', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='blue')

# Twin axis for conversion rate
ax1_twin = ax1.twinx()
line = ax1_twin.plot(months, conversion_rate, 'o-', color='orange', label='Conversion Rate (%)')
ax1_twin.set_ylabel('Conversion Rate (%)', fontsize=12)
ax1_twin.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='orange')

# Combined legend in upper left of top panel
lines, labels = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax1_twin.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax1.legend(lines + lines2, labels + labels2, loc='upper left')

# Horizontal dashed grid in both panels
ax1.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
ax2.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Bottom panel - Cumulative Orders (step plot with where='mid')
ax2.step(months, cumulative_orders, where='mid', color='purple', label='Cumulative Orders')

# Annotate each cumulative value
for i, (month, value) in enumerate(zip(months, cumulative_orders)):
    ax2.text(i, value, f'{value}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

ax2.set_ylabel('Cumulative Orders', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_xlabel('Month', fontsize=12)

# Set y-axis limits
ax1.set_ylim(0, max(visits) * 1.1)
ax1_twin.set_ylim(0, max(conversion_rate) * 1.1)
ax2.set_ylim(0, max(cumulative_orders) * 1.1)

# Set suptitle
fig.suptitle('Monthly Funnel Performance', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=120, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Figure saved as figure.png")
EOF
"}
